results.title: After Japan's APEC snub, what's next for its China ties?
results.content: Japan has long-running concerns over Chinese military expansionism, and Beijing has bristled at Sanae Takaichi's comments on Taiwan. The frosty ties were on full display at the APEC summit.

results.title: Nepal's new PM eyes closer ties with India amid lingering disputes
results.content: On his first foreign bilateral visit, rapper-turned-Prime Minister Balendra Shah sought deeper ties with Nepal's neighbor and largest trading partner, while steering clear of sticky territorial issues.

results.title: North Macedonia remains stalled on its EU path after 21 years as a candidate
results.content: EU enlargement has regained momentum, with Montenegro and Albania moving closer to membership. But North Macedonia, a candidate since 2005, remains stalled by a politically difficult dispute involving Bulgaria.

results.title: Uganda minister at COP31: 'We need a just transition'
results.content: Funding from wealthy countries to help deal with the impacts of climate change hasn't materialized, says Uganda's environment minister. The East African country is hoping oil and carbon credits will help boost finances.

results.title: German police respond to multiple school bomb threats
results.content: Police in Germany are responding to bomb threats against a series of schools, but say that at present they don't believe them to be credible. Danish authorities are reporting a similar series of apparent hoaxes.

results.title: China, ASEAN countries struggle over South China Sea code of conduct
results.content: The Philippines wanted a South China Sea code of conduct in place by 2026. But persistent disagreements between China and ASEAN countries are slowing progress toward a deal.

results.title: Dozens missing as deadly fire tears through Indonesian candy factory
results.content: At least 24 people were killed in a devastating fire at a confectionery factory on Java. Officials said many more people remain unaccounted for, prompting fears of a much larger tragedy.

results.title: Mexican special forces arrest drug kingpin 'Chapo Isidro'
results.content: The alleged leader of the Beltran Leyva gang and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, known as "Chapo Isidro," was captured by the Mexican military following a raid and a shootout in the coastal state of Sinaloa.

results.title: Russian helicopter suspected of violating Finnish airspace
results.content: Finland's Defense Ministry thinks the incursion is linked to a drone strike earlier Saturday on a Russian cargo ship, which is on a US sanctions list.

results.title: EU and Indonesia sign trade deal
results.content: A deal covering 730 million people promises lower tariffs and new investment opportunities as the European Union seeks to diversify trade ties amid growing global economic tensions.

results.title: EU takes aim at tech giants in tax proposal
results.content: European Council President Antonio Costa has proposed a smaller EU budget for 2028-2034, including a 3% tax on major digital firms to ease member states' contributions. France has already rejected the plan as inadequate.
